mapper.sql: e.employee_code AS employeeId, e.employee_name AS name, d.dept_code AS deptId, COALESCE(p.position_name, '') AS position, COALESCE(jl.level_name, '') AS jobLevel, COALESCE((SELECT COALESCE(r.final_grade, r.grade) FROM hr_evaluation_result r JOIN hr_evaluation_task t ON r.task_id = t.id JOIN hr_evaluation_cycle c ON t.cycle_id = c.id WHERE r.employee_id = e.id AND r.deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.end_date DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT 1), 'UNRATED') AS performanceGrade, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, e.entry_date, CURDATE()) AS tenureYears, e.employment_type AS employmentType, e.status AS status, COALESCE(e.email, '') AS email, COALESCE(e.phone, '') AS phone
FROM hr_employee e LEFT JOIN hr_department d ON e.dept_id = d.id LEFT JOIN hr_position p ON e.position_id = p.id LEFT JOIN hr_job_level jl ON e.level_id = jl.id
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE e.deleted = 0
AND d.dept_code IN #{code}
ORDER BY e.id
mapper.sql: d.dept_code AS deptId, d.dept_name AS deptName, pd.dept_code AS parentDeptId, d.head_employee_code AS headEmployeeId, d.head_count AS headcount, d.current_staff AS currentStaff, d.turnover_rate AS turnoverRate, d.probation_pass_rate AS probationPassRate
mapper.select: SELECT FROM hr_department d LEFT JOIN hr_department pd ON d.parent_dept_id = pd.id WHERE d.deleted = 0 AND d.dept_code = #{deptCode} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hr_department WHERE deleted = 0
mapper.sql: e.employee_code AS employeeId, c.cycle_name AS cycle, r.total_score AS score, COALESCE(r.final_grade, r.grade) AS grade, r.appealed AS appealed
mapper.select: SELECT FROM hr_evaluation_result r JOIN hr_evaluation_task t ON r.task_id = t.id JOIN hr_evaluation_cycle c ON t.cycle_id = c.id JOIN hr_employee e ON r.employee_id = e.id WHERE r.deleted = 0 ORDER BY e.id, c.end_date DESC
